read.json._description: Tool read: read a text file as plain lines, in parts if it is big.

ls.json._description: Tool ls: list one folder, one line per item; long and json for details.

view.json._description: Tool view: look into a file step by step: JSON level by level, big text as an outline first.

stat.json._description: Tool stat: facts about one file, folder or link as JSON (type, size, lines, format).

json_read.json._description: Tool json_read: one place in a JSON file, a few levels deep; deeper parts folded.

write.json._description: Tool write: write a whole file (new, or fully replaced).

edit.json._description: Tool edit: change part of a text file by exact text replacement.

copy.json._description: Tool copy: copy a file or a whole folder to a new path.

move.json._description: Tool move: move or rename a file, folder or link; also brings things back from the trash.

mkdir.json._description: Tool mkdir: create a folder with its parents; an existing folder is fine.

json_write.json._description: Tool json_write: set or delete values in a JSON file by JSON Pointer.

trash.json._description: Tool trash: delete so it can be undone (moved into .trash/ in your workspace).

remove.json._description: Tool remove: delete for real, like rm; no undo (a folder needs recursive).

shell.json._description: Tool shell: run one bash command line in your workspace; output ends with [exit code N].

run_python.json._description: Tool run_python: run a short Python 3 program; output ends with [exit code N].

peek_clock.json._description: Tool peek_clock: the daemon clock's current cycle and how many ms one cycle is.

peek_now_time.json._description: Tool peek_now_time: the current time of day in UTC.

math.json._description: Tool math: compute one arithmetic expression; what is allowed, examples, ExprBad.
